item.title: The Trouble with the Soft Sciences
item.description: The case of Jason Arday shows that many social scientists today have little interest in pursuing truth.

item.title: The Myth of the Miserable Housewife
item.description: Contrary to popular belief, marriage and motherhood remain the most reliable and fulfilling sources of meaning and joy.

item.title: Why Missouri Declined to Abolish Its Income Tax
item.description: Voters chose the familiar option due to uncertainty about the consequences.

item.title: American missionary in Niger released after 10 months of captivity
item.description: Kevin Rideout, an American missionary abducted in Niger last October, has been freed after over 10 months in captivity.
